purpose: Track independent historical station observation options for validating the ERA5-Land regional baseline. Accessible source pages do not imply all 80 subregions have matched stations or downloadable 1991-2020 records.
rules: Station observations remain independent from ERA5/ERA5-Land reanalysis.
Match station ID and valid observation date; preserve local observation-day definition, QC flags, station relocation/history, elevation and distance.
Do not claim station validation until records are downloaded, paired and quality checked.
Record fees, licensing and access limits before acquisition.

sources.notes: JMA official Past Weather Data Download provides daily values including daily precipitation total, daily maximum and minimum temperature. The portal exposes quality/insufficient-data handling and flags non-homogeneity due to station relocation, environmental or observation-method changes. It limits request volume and warns against excessive automated access. A bounded cluster-level acquisition queue is generated; station matching and 1991-2020 downloads remain pending.

KMA official ASOS portal provides daily records from 1904 onward depending on station and element, with 105 ASOS stations listed. Daily query window is limited to 10 years; long historical periods are directed to annual file-set downloads. A bounded cluster-level acquisition queue is generated; station matching and 1991-2020 downloads remain pending.

CMA open data catalogue lists national ground basic observations and a 1991-2020 ground climate normal dataset; historical international exchange station data also listed. Need identify the correct access portal, station inventory, download terms and usable elements before matching.
Official response says stations are available, records generally begin 1977 onward, hourly or daily formats; access is fee-based and requires contacting the data center.

TMD states about 1,200 stations and 127 WMO-standard observing stations; historical climate statistics require paid service. Its data portal lists station metadata, daily/monthly rainfall statistics and observations. Need confirm downloadable historical station data, terms and record lengths.

Official MET Malaysia ArcGIS Stesen MET layer was queried and 80 location candidates were ranked across all 8 Malaysia golf subregions. Every subregion has at least one official station location within 75 km. Layer station types include AWS, AWS - VAISALA, CLIMATOLOGICAL and RAINFALL. The location layer does not establish historical element coverage or daily record availability; request station IDs, station history and 1991-2020 daily PRCP/TMAX/TMIN availability before approving.
Official portal provides daily station records; coverage and record duration vary by station. Some additional climate data requires paid extraction.
SACA&D daily station series partly free for non-commercial research; availability varies. BMKG Data Online has access limits for some data products; confirm terms before commercial use.

NOAA GHCN-Daily station and element-inventory metadata were downloaded and ranked for all 80 regional points. Initial output: 791 top-10 candidate rows; all 80 regions have at least one station with PRCP/TMAX/TMIN inventory overlap during 1991-2020; 76 regions have a complete-element candidate within 75 km. Four Malaysia regions had no suitable NOAA candidate within 75 km; all four now have closer official MET Malaysia station-location candidates. Inventory overlap is not proof of daily completeness; no station is approved and no observation records were downloaded. A bounded pilot downloaded actual NOAA .dly records for 238 candidates across all 80 regions (up to 3 per region), with zero download failures. All 238 stations had at least one valid record for each required element, but mean annual daily coverage across the pilot was PRCP 59.6%, TMAX 76.1%, TMIN 57.2%; only 6 of 80 regions had at least one sampled candidate with all three elements averaging at least 80% annual coverage and at least 80% coverage in 20 or more years. These screening metrics are not station approval; candidate choice is limited to top-3 distance-ranked candidates and requires national-network alternatives and station-history review.

nextActions: Generate the Japan and Korea cluster-level station acquisition queue from representative-point coordinates, then match official station inventories to each cluster.
Acquire bounded 1991-2020 daily JMA and KMA records for shortlisted stations; preserve source QC, insufficient-data and non-homogeneity flags.
Expand NOAA candidate discovery beyond the nearest three stations per region, prioritizing PRCP and TMIN daily completeness; no station approval from inventory overlap alone.
Search official national meteorological station datasets for China, Vietnam, Thailand, Malaysia, Singapore and Indonesia, documenting access terms and data fees.
Obtain station history, relocation, elevation and terrain/coastal representativeness before pairing station observations with ERA5-Land.

discoverySummary.interpretation: The first actual-record pilot succeeded technically for 238 candidates across all 80 regions with zero download failures. However, coverage is insufficient for broad station approval: precipitation and especially minimum-temperature daily records are incomplete for many stations. Only 6 regions had a sampled candidate meeting the preliminary combined coverage screen. Expand national-network matching, validate station history and observation-day conventions, and compare daily values with ERA5-Land before any station is approved.
discoverySummary.ghcndDailyAuditDefinition: A region has a strong pilot candidate only if one of its sampled stations has all three elements with mean annual daily coverage >=80% and >=20 years at >=80%; this is a screening threshold, not approval.
